turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Good morning everyone, thanks for joining the sprint planning call. Let's start with the backend status. Bob, can you walk us through where we are with the payments API?

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Sure. The payments API is about eighty percent done. The Stripe integration is working, but we still need to handle refunds and webhooks. I think I can finish the refund flow by Friday.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Great. Refunds by Friday works for the demo. What about the webhook retries? That was a concern last week.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Right, I'll set up the retry queue with exponential backoff. I'll have a design doc ready by Wednesday for review.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: On the frontend side, the checkout page is done and tested on mobile. But I'm blocked on the new design tokens from the design team. I've been waiting since Monday.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Okay, I'll follow up with the design team today and get those tokens to you by end of day. Carol, once you have them, how long to integrate?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: About two days. So if I get them today, I can finish the integration by Thursday. I'll also write the end to end tests for checkout.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Perfect. Now, the big decision: do we launch on the fifteenth or push to the twenty second? Bob, what's your honest take?

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Honestly, the fifteenth is risky. The refund flow and webhooks need proper testing. I'd recommend the twenty second so we have a full week of QA.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: I agree with Bob. A rushed launch could hurt us. Let's go with the twenty second.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Alright, it's decided. We launch on the twenty second. Bob, you own the payments QA checklist. Carol, you own the frontend regression tests. I'll handle the launch announcement and the staging deploy.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Sounds good. One more thing, we need to decide on the monitoring tool. I've been evaluating Grafana and Datadog.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Let's table that for now. Bob, put together a comparison doc and we'll decide next Monday. Thanks everyone, good meeting.

integrate design tokens and finish checkout
write end to end tests for checkout

decisions: Table the monitoring tool decision until next Monday
